shortDescription.default: Work Boards - boards, Kanban and timelines for team and project work in SharePoint

longDescription.default: Work Boards is a work and project management app for SharePoint Online: boards with groups, items and subitems, Status, People, Timeline and other columns, table, Kanban and Timeline (Gantt) views, updates with @mentions, files, activity history and My Work. It sets up its own hidden lists on each site where it is added, and uses only SharePoint REST as the signed-in user - no Azure AD app registration, client id or Microsoft Graph permissions.
